h1: Hotel reservation for a visa application
lead: Accommodation proof and flights should tell the same story. Here is what we cover and how to line the two up.
body: BuyDummyFlights currently provides **flight reservations only**. We do not sell hotel reservations at this time. This page explains how accommodation evidence fits into a visa file so you can plan it alongside your itinerary.

Many visa checklists ask for proof of where you will stay: a hotel booking that covers each night, or an invitation letter from a host with their address and contact details. Dates on that proof should match your itinerary and your application form. See our [visa application checklist](/blog/visa-application-checklist) for the full list.

- Check-in should be on or just after your arrival date.
- Check-out should be on or before your departure date.
- Avoid gaps in the stay unless you can explain them.
- If you will stay with a host for part of the trip, include their invitation.

- A hotel or booking platform booking with free cancellation, if you want to avoid paying in advance.
- A letter from a host, following the format your embassy asks for.
Always read the cancellation terms and keep the confirmation emails. Check the official checklist for what the embassy accepts.

A flight reservation fixes your arrival and departure dates, which makes booking accommodation easier. See [how it works](/how-it-works) or the [Schengen visa page](/dummy-ticket-for-schengen-visa) for an example of matching dates. The [FAQ](/faq) answers common questions.
> We cannot promise that any document will be accepted. Always follow the official requirements for your application.

- Hotel dates that leave unexplained gaps in the stay
- Booking names that do not match the passport
- Cancellation terms that expire before the visa decision
- Mixing up booking references between different documents
- Relying on a flight document to show where you will stay

Decide your dates, get your flight document, then arrange accommodation that fits the same dates, then check the whole file for consistency. Our [visa application checklist](/blog/visa-application-checklist) has a step-by-step version.

Q: Do you provide hotel reservations?
A: Not currently. We provide flight reservations only.

Q: Do I need accommodation proof for every visa?
A: No. Check the official checklist for yours.
